foundation_requirements.expected: Consume native encode_assertion/curation_revision/source_ref_for without a Consumer hash helper; existing Robotics/Semiconductor references retain meaning.
Preserve a legitimately signed financial source value and downstream -4/-114925 derivations in their proper owners; negative physical quantities remain invalid. No absolute-value or zero coercion.
Required period, economic role, unit, scale, precision and sign convention remain available; incompatible or unmeasured values cannot form a reported comparable delta.
Two absent basis/perimeter/definition values do not establish equality for a Consumer comparison; keep the supported values visible and withhold the unsupported assessment.
Two reporting releases addressing one annual target remain two outlooks, not an actual or fabricated annual results event; consume accepted history and comparison rather than another estimates store.
Adding, correcting, suppressing or removing Consumer content must preserve eligible unrelated Semiconductor/Robotics/Earnings records and remain correct on the next ordinary publication.
Authentication/entitlement precede protected-body access; warm-cache revocation applies before the next prohibited emission, including hidden counts and evidence labels.
An unresolved business remains source-labelled without a fabricated issuer or canonical theme. Only owner-validated relationships create company/theme navigation.
Consumer mounts through accepted shared client/route/shell and domain content, not a second dashboard or semiconductor wafer/stage fields relabelled as consumer economics.
After a source correction, numbers, interpretation, table, evidence drawer and cross-page navigation refer to the same selected owner revisions or explicitly disclose the section-level failure.
Research associations and multi-theme company roles do not alter live member selection/order, price baskets, ranking, entry, sizing or trade decisions.
The admitted PLNT inputs produce useful growth-versus-retained-economics explanation, preserving the -4 USD-thousand derived residual, not just an endpoint or warning.
Use matching H1 source legs to display 85266 company-defined FCF and -114925 pre-sale-leaseback subtotal in USD thousands, without calling the subtotal normalized maintenance cash.
Preserve the dated same-target ranges, exact source versus system clocks and basis limitations. No management-guidance-to-consensus or historical-publication claim without its own evidence.
The reader can identify what changed, the exposed economic role, cash/profit mechanism, counterevidence and next condition; a generic BOM, metadata table or empty refusal does not pass.

Do not require full Semiconductor B, C1 global entities or LULU history before permitted PLNT/LTH work. Full Consumer first-vertical acceptance still requires all three positive cases plus governed navigation and independent proof.

Release-only records bind their own event/source references and clocks; no invented transcript context.
An unavailable Consumer source yields an explicit unavailable/historical record while valid unrelated earnings can advance.
Stale or ambiguous pointer promotion is reconciled through the current single writer; no new lock plane or blind retry.
Private profile registration does not alter public automatic selection or publish the full new fact closure.
No exact public-availability or guaranteed fixed-lag claim is derived from SEC acceptance alone.
Wrong-issuer/stale responses are ignored and paid DOM is cleared on logout without public fallback.
Different selected event generations are allowed when explicitly referenced; incompatible revisions of one selected event are rejected.
PLNT/LTH do not acquire an unnecessary dependency on LULU history or an invented theme.
